bucket_reason: Low confidence at observe: the global epoch/bit-creation law is unknown, so proof work waits for a priority call.
question: Spend one more stage on the epoch/bit-creation law (wall catalogue plus an abstract wall simulator), or park R9 as STUCK at observe?

options.label: Park as STUCK at observe, plus one niced background run to 1e12 as a cheap halt check
options.consequence: No agent time beyond the launch. The run takes about 70 min at about 250M steps/s (the tape is about 2,000 cells), and it extends the halting evidence from 1e10 to 1e12. The sheet says nobody has simulated this machine to 1e14. A halt would be a KILLED_HALT lead; no halt changes nothing.

options.label: One more stage (2 h): exact wall catalogue in both sea phases, an abstract walls-and-counters simulator checked against the TM, then the epoch law
options.consequence: The likely result is the inner levels catalogued, with the epoch law and the 2.7e9 regime change still open. A proof would still need a global invariant over several levels with no template.

rationale: Only the bottom level is understood. The sea sweeps, the wall toggles and both inner counter laws are exact (33,140/33,140 and 5,545/5,545 turns on the orbit). Above that level there are several unknowns: a second engine/counter pair, edge structures, engine-dissolving epochs (43 between 1e9 and 2.73e9, then none in the inner region), and a regime change at about 2.7e9 that 1e10 steps may not fully show. The defect algebra has real halting routes (B> 1^n 0 1 0, or a D sweep meeting 110), so non-halting needs a global invariant on defect shapes. qsim does not accelerate it and no template applies. Edge visits keep slowing (near 8e9 the left edge is visited about once per 1.5e9 steps), so each new regime costs more simulation. One stage is unlikely to make this machine proof-ready, while other machines are one stage away from proof work. The 1e12 run costs almost nothing and is the one cheap way to learn something new.

evidence.text: 7 exact local rules at 200/200 each (S_R, S_L, RB0, RB1, RB1r, LB0, D_R) and the halt pattern H at 400/400. The inner counter laws hold on the orbit: 33,140/33,140 (right) and 5,545/5,545 (left).
Not understood: the right-end engine/counter pair, the edge structures, and the engine-dissolving epochs (EP has no exact rule). The regime changed at about 2.73e9.
Edge records to 1e10: +3 cells per edge visit, visits slowing; 2,021 cells at 1e10.
Card Fig 3: where the head turns, log time to 1e9 (several separate wall systems).
Card Fig 1: edge records to 10 billion steps.
